fields: h, intro, topics, items [{t, topic, std, date, link, featured, spot, d}], fold, fold_noun. Never a date that is not given (the dashed page status instead); the lead note is the featured one, else the first of the first topic. Filtering shows every matching note, folded or not; notes that stay glide to their new places and new ones fade in.
best_for: RevisionRegister keeps technical notes as the numbered notes column of one limestone drawing sheet: the title large and light with the lead note under it, a faint drawing of the page a note is applied on, and the register in mono behind a hairline rule, with a topic filter and a title block carrying the live count.
